verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, a professional-services business rather than a software product, so background autonomous automations are a category error for it. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation or scheduling capability; its DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool is a one-off assessment, not a recurring background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
